properties.name: Orléans
properties.subtitle: Centre-Val de Loire, France
properties.claim: Joan of Arc's voices and visions, her unexplained military competence and her knowledge of a hidden sword are presented as guidance from a non-human source.
properties.context: Joan's trial and rehabilitation transcripts are exceptionally full primary records, and they document her own description of the voices as saints. The military record shows a figure of immense morale value operating alongside experienced commanders such as Dunois and La Hire. Medieval visionary experience is a well-studied religious and historical phenomenon.
properties.summary: Orléans (US: ; French: [ɔʁleɑ̃] ) is a city in north-central France, about 120 kilometres (74 miles) southwest of Paris. It is the prefecture of the department of Loiret, within the region of Centre-Val de Loire.
